xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
Logical RPC arrows show the caller awaiting a correlated RabbitMQ response; transport envelopes are abstracted.
Revoked recovery predicate is exactly repository checks: old request identity+window and valid encrypted replacement; absolute-expiry check belongs to active nonrevoked branch.
Rotation-conflict fallback checks request identity/window then reads replacement; it is not claimed to repeat every revoked-recovery check (auth.repository.ts:192-220).
